description: Land Title Settlement Department - Helamada, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, ownership details (including both private and state ownership), and land classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
